Next: trim item, use template literals, validate with Number.isInteger and Number.isFinite, stop after the first ERROR or print exactly four labeled lines.

All acceptance criteria pass: labeled console.log output, formatMoney with two decimals, and exact README error strings for item, quantity, and unitPrice. Validation correctly uses Number(), Number.isInteger, and Number.isFinite. Solid match to the lesson concepts and functional requirements.
